title: 第17章 云生百相第18章 碑前秘语
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
云擎背脊瞬间僵直，如同被无形的手扼住，半晌才缓缓松弛下来。他抬头，望向栖梧殿主殿的方向，月光勾勒出他挺拔的身影，重瞳在夜色里幽深难测。
云擎闭眼，各方势力如同纵横交错的棋线，而他自己，既是执棋者，亦是棋盘上最危险的那颗棋子。他低声自语，唇角勾起一抹微笑，如同雪地里折射的月光。
“诸位，欲以我为棋，为鼎，为踏脚石……那便看看，我等谁能，执子问鼎！”
栖梧殿内，云煌斜倚在玄玉书案旁，漫不经心地摩挲着一枚玉简，他神色漫不经心，眼瞳深处却藏着一丝冷漠玩味。
“剥离本源，造就伪体？十二长老那点手段，也配觊觎混沌道胎？”他嗤笑一声，玉简上浮现一道虚影，正是方才云擎负手而立、神色冷冽的模样。
“暴殄天物。”云煌漠然评价。徒具其形，难承其神，他们根本不明白“混沌道胎”真正的价值何在。
此等体质，即便在远古洪荒也是凤毛麟角，堪称天地间最完美的“道基”。混沌包容世界、衍化万物的特性，对于需要重塑根基、融合万法、乃至追求更高层次蜕变的强大存在而言，是无上至宝。甚至对他这仙帝转世之身，都有难以估量的裨益。
云煌指尖轻点，云擎的虚影瞬间化作一缕混沌灵力在他掌心盘旋。“若本君欲行那夺基换鼎之事……”这念头在他脑中一闪而过，随即被一抹更为复杂的情绪取代。
“譬如芝兰玉树，欲使其生于庭阶耳。”他慢声吟哦，清冽的嗓音在大殿中回荡。
既然这株难得的仙苗已在他庭院中扎根，且生长得如此合乎心意，他又何必急于一时，行那焚琴煮鹤之事？好生栽培，令其枝繁叶茂，自成一景，岂不妙哉？
云煌目光穿透重重殿宇，落在了静心院那道挺拔修长的身影上，嘴角勾起一抹危险的笑容“罢了，这样才有赏玩之趣。”
难怪自己总是不自觉地对他多几分宽容，这般惊世天赋，配上那恭顺狡黠、锋芒内蕴的性子，确实颇为有趣。
本想今日便将混沌道胎的隐秘彻底点破，好生吓唬一下他那总爱底线蹦迪的兄长。奈何二长老在场，此事关乎重大，外人还是不要知道为好。
云煌在夜色中唇角微勾，那笑容衬得他俊美的面容诡谲莫测“改日再寻个机会与他‘细细分说’也不迟…”
还是看云擎在各方势力间从容斡旋的模样更有意思。至于其他人，他神识如无形的潮水，缓缓扫过整个云氏宗族，带着一丝漠然的审视。
棋盘已备，棋子已动，他这位执棋之人，只需静观其变，偶尔……落子惊风雷。
“这通天大弈，才刚刚开始。”
……
夜色渐浓，云浩的院落里，气氛压抑而悲伤。
云浩被废，如同抽掉了这一房的主心骨。其父母围着昏迷不醒的儿子哭天抢地，更是将怨气撒在了五长老和云如意身上。

“父亲！您为何如此狠心！浩儿可是您的嫡亲血脉啊！”云浩母亲哭诉着，眼神怨毒，“您就眼睁睁看着那云煌下此狠手吗？！我的浩儿啊！他还是个孩子，他做错了什么？！”
云浩父亲也在一旁帮腔“是啊父亲，哪有不疼自家子嗣反偏向外人的道理！若不是您偏心，将那些顶级资源都给云如意那个不知来历的野种！丝毫不顾及我们，浩儿怎么会心生不满，又怎么会兵行险招，落到这般田地！”
“我又怎么会到如今还只是区区合体境！”显然，最后这句恐怕才是他的真心。
五长老云钧脸上满是疲惫，实在不愿理这些不成器的东西。
他想到今日栖梧殿内，云煌眼中暗藏的冷酷和云魑看似求情实则挑拨的诛心之言……风雨欲来啊。
他或许中庸，但绝不蠢，这潭水太深，他和他这一脉，不能再掺和了。绝不能让云如意受到任何牵连！那才是他们这一脉真正的福缘所在。
五长老浑浊的老眼中闪过一丝明悟与决断。他猛地一拍桌子，顶尖强者的威压瞬间镇住了哭闹的儿子儿媳：“闭嘴！你们当真以为我老糊涂了，不知道你们背地里和十二长老搞的那些龌龊勾当？！若非老夫尚有几分薄面，少君只惩处了浩儿，你们以为我们这一脉还能安然无恙？！”
他声音沉痛严厉“当年老夫流落荒野，重伤濒死，若不是小如意救了我，又以自身福缘为我续命，老夫早就是一抔黄土，哪还能好端端站在这里，让你们享这么久的富贵荣华？！”
“父亲！”
不待二人反驳，五长老目光锐利地扫过现在还拎不清的儿子和怨愤的儿媳，斩钉截铁道：“我云氏历来，能者居上。浩儿心术不正又技不如人，老夫拼着这张老脸保他一命，已是尽了血亲之情！明日，你们一房，还有所有参与此事的仆役、执事，全部给老夫收拾东西，滚去荒城静思己过，没有我的命令，永不得归！”
云浩父母被五长老这突如其来的雷霆之怒和毫不留情的处置惊呆了。他们印象中的父亲，向来是温和慈善甚至有些优柔寡断的，何曾有过如此决绝狠辣的一面？！
刚在云擎手里极限求生的贾执事，紧接着便接到发配荒城的命令时是怎样崩溃，暂且不提。
十二长老洞府，结界内。
云魑脸色难看地汇报完栖梧殿的经过：“祖父，那云擎去了执律殿，又见了二长老。少君那边…似乎也没有进一步追究宗祠之事的迹象。可恶，怎么就这么轻飘飘放过云擎了？！”
十二长老面容干瘦阴鸷，手中摩挲着一枚漆黑的骨符，声音沙哑：“哼，云擎小儿，倒是小看了他笼络人心的手段。”
“那我们接下来…”云魑眼中的急切与贪婪几乎溢出，“孙儿的噬灵体已到瓶颈，若再无法得到精纯的混沌本源。”
“急什么！”十二长老冷斥一声，“云擎如今气运正盛，少君又隐隐偏向于他，硬碰硬非是上策。宗祠之事未能一举建功，已经打草惊蛇。”
听到这话，云魑心有余悸地问道：“祖父，少君他是不是察觉了什么？今日分明是警告！”
十二长老眼中老谋深算，不在意的说：“云煌心思难测，但他既未立刻发作，便说明此事尚有转圜余地。上位者驭下，如同养蛊，总是乐见底下人为了讨好他而争斗，优胜劣汰而已。我们要在他真正将云擎视为心腹之前，拿到混沌道胎！”
云魑眼中野心与不安交织闪烁：“可是祖父，我们为何一定要依附那云煌？若能得到完整的混沌道胎，我们祖孙按照这骨符记载之法炼化，未必不能……”

“住口！此事绝不可再提！”十二长老厉声喝止，神色恐惧。

content_en:
Yun Qing's back instantly stiffened, as if being strangled by invisible hands, and then slowly relaxed after a long while. He raised his head and looked in the direction of the main hall of Qiwu Hall. The moonlight outlined his tall figure, and his heavy eyes were unpredictable in the night.
Yun Qing closed his eyes, and all the forces were like criss-crossing chess lines, and he himself was both the chess player and the most dangerous piece on the chess board. He whispered to himself, with a smile on his lips, like the moonlight refracted in the snow.
"Everyone, if you want to use me as a chess piece, a tripod, or a stepping stone... then let's see who among us can win the title!"
In the Qiwu Hall, Yunhuang was leaning against the Xuanyu bookcase, carelessly stroking a jade slip. His expression was careless, but there was a trace of indifference and amusement hidden deep in his eyes.
"Strip off the origin and create a fake body? Are the Twelve Elders worthy of coveting the Chaos Dao Fetus with their little tricks?" He sneered, and a shadow appeared on the jade slip. It was exactly the way Yun Qing stood with his hands behind his back just now, with a cold look on his face.
"What a waste of natural resources." Yunhuang commented indifferently. It only has its form but cannot inherit its spirit. They simply don't understand the true value of the "Chaos Taoist Embryo".
This kind of physique is rare even in ancient times, and it can be called the most perfect "Tao foundation" in the world. Chaos' ability to encompass the world and evolve all things is a supreme treasure for powerful beings who need to reshape their foundations, integrate all methods, or even pursue higher levels of transformation. It would even be of immeasurable benefit to him, the reincarnation of the Immortal Emperor.
Yunhuang tapped his fingertips, and Yun Qing's shadow instantly turned into a wisp of chaotic spiritual power hovering in his palm. "If I want to do that thing of seizing the foundation and replacing the tripod..." This thought flashed through his mind, and was immediately replaced by a more complicated emotion.
"Like the orchid and jade tree, I want it to grow on the steps of the courtyard." He chanted slowly, his clear voice echoing in the hall.
Since this rare fairy seedling has taken root in his courtyard and is growing so well to his liking, why should he rush to burn the harp and boil the crane? Wouldn't it be wonderful to cultivate it well and make it flourish and form a scene of its own?
Yunhuang's eyes penetrated through the many palaces and fell on the tall and slender figure in the Jingxin courtyard. A dangerous smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, "That's all, this is the fun of watching."
No wonder I always tend to be more tolerant of him unconsciously. Such an astonishing talent, coupled with his submissive, cunning, and sharp temperament, is indeed quite interesting.
He wanted to completely reveal the secret of Chaos Tao Ti today, so as to scare his brother who always loves to dance on the bottom line. However, the second elder is present. This matter is of great importance, so it is best not for outsiders to know.
The corners of Yunhuang's lips curled up slightly in the night, and the smile made his handsome face look strange and unpredictable. "It wouldn't be too late to find an opportunity to 'discuss' with him in detail some other time..."
It is more interesting to see how Yun Qing calmly mediates between the various forces. As for the others, his consciousness was like an invisible tide, slowly sweeping across the entire Yun clan with a hint of indifference.
The chessboard is ready and the pieces are in motion. As the chess player, he only needs to wait and see what happens. Occasionally... his moves will shock the wind and thunder.
"This great game has just begun."
…
The night is getting darker, and the atmosphere in Yunhao's courtyard is depressing and sad.
Yunhao's being deposed was like taking away the backbone of this house. His parents cried and cried around their unconscious son, and even directed their grievances against the fifth elder and Yun Ruyi.
"Father! Why are you so cruel! Hao'er is your direct bloodline!" Yun Hao's mother cried, her eyes filled with resentment, "Are you just watching Yun Huang do this cruel thing?! My Hao'er! He is still a child, what did he do wrong?!"
Yun Hao's father also spoke up, "Yes, father, how can you not love your own children but favor outsiders! If you weren't biased, you would have given all those top resources to that unknown bastard Yun Ruyi! Without caring about us at all, how could Hao'er be dissatisfied and make dangerous moves?"Falling into this situation! "
"How could I still be in the combined state now? "Obviously, this last sentence may be his sincerity.
Fifth Elder Yunjun's face was full of exhaustion, and he really didn't want to pay attention to these useless things.
He thought of the coldness hidden in Yun Huang's eyes in Qiwu Hall today and Yun Zhi's heart-breaking words that seemed to be pleading but were actually provocative... A storm was coming.
He may be mediocre, but he is by no means stupid. This pool of water is too deep, and he and his lineage can no longer mix. We must not let Yun Ruyi get involved in any way! That is the true blessing of their lineage.
A glimmer of understanding and determination flashed through the fifth elder's cloudy old eyes. He slammed the table, and the coercion of the top powerhouse instantly suppressed his crying son and daughter-in-law: "Shut up! Do you really think that I am an old fool and don’t know about the dirty deeds you are doing behind the scenes with the Twelve Elders? ! If I hadn't been a bit mean-spirited and Young Master only punished Hao'er, do you think our lineage would still be safe and sound? ! "
His voice was deep and stern, "Back then, I was living in the wilderness and was seriously injured and on the verge of death. If Xiao Ruyi hadn't saved me and extended my life with her own good fortune, I would have been a handful of dirt. How could I have been able to stand here and let you enjoy the wealth and glory for so long? ! "
"Father! "
Without waiting for the two to retort, the fifth elder glanced sharply at his still unclear son and resentful daughter-in-law, and said categorically: "In our Yun family, the most capable people always come first. Hao'er has evil intentions and inferior skills. I have done my best to save his life by using this old face to protect him! Tomorrow, all of you, as well as all the servants and deacons involved in this matter, will pack your things for me and go to the deserted city to meditate on your past. Without my order, you will never return! "
Yunhao's parents were stunned by the fifth elder's sudden thunderous fury and merciless treatment. The father they remembered was always gentle, charitable and even a little indecisive. How could he ever have such a decisive and ruthless side? !
Let’s not even mention how Deacon Jia collapsed when he received the order to be dispatched to Huangcheng.
Twelve Elders Cave Mansion, inside the barrier.
Yun Qing finished reporting what happened in Qiwu Hall with an ugly face: "Grandpa, Yun Qing went to Zhilu Hall and met the second elder again. There seems to be no sign of Shaojun pursuing the matter of the ancestral hall further. Damn it, why did you let Yun Qing go so easily? ! "
The twelfth elder had a thin and gloomy face, rubbing a dark bone talisman in his hand, and said in a hoarse voice: "Huh, little Yun Qing, I have underestimated his ability to win over people's hearts. "
"Then let's go on..." The eagerness and greed in Yun Chi's eyes almost overflowed, "My grandson's spirit-devouring body has reached its bottleneck. If we can no longer obtain the pure source of chaos. "
"What's the hurry! "The Twelve Elders scolded him coldly, "Yun Qing's fortune is booming now, and the young master is vaguely biased towards him. It's not the best idea to go head-to-head with him. The incident at the ancestral hall failed to achieve success in one fell swoop, and it has already been done to scare the snake. "
Hearing this, Yunji asked with lingering fear: "Grandpa, did Young Master notice something? Today is clearly a warning! "
The twelfth elder looked scheming in his eyes and said nonchalantly: "Yunhuang's thoughts are unpredictable, but since he didn't attack immediately, it means there is still room for change in the matter. The person in charge controlling his subordinates is like raising a poison. He is always happy to see the subordinates fighting to please him. It is just the survival of the fittest. We need to get the Chaos Taoist Tire before he truly regards Yun Qing as his confidant! "
Ambition and uneasiness intertwined in Yun Qi's eyes: "But Grandpa, why do we have to rely on Yun Huang? If we can obtain a complete Chaos Dao Embryo, our ancestors and grandchildren may not be able to refine it according to the method recorded in this bone talisman..."
"Shut up! Never mention this again! "The twelfth elder shouted to stop, looking frightened.
